data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Genesia is the goddess of remembrance and recollection. The name Genesia comes from the Greek word genos, meaning race, family, or origin. As a Christian name, it may symbolize remembering and treasuring one's spiritual heritage. The name Genesia carries the meaning “Memory, Recollection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Genesia usually hope their child will grow to embody memory, recollection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
